resources.string: Hold Ctrl + A–Z to launch an app

Remove the phone’s built-in letter shortcuts first. In KISS search, hold Ctrl and an assigned letter together. Plain letters keep using your IME. Assigned Ctrl chords are reserved: a short press does nothing. Shift, Alt and Meta combinations are not shortcuts. Release Ctrl, press another key or touch the screen to cancel. This is an alternative to letter-only long press.
The assigned app is unavailable. Check the shortcut settings.
